rules.active: May be routed to and executed when its normal gates pass.
rules.frozen: Must not receive new work, schedules, credentials, monitoring, upgrades or failover traffic. Historical evidence may remain only when clearly marked.
rules.forbidden: Must not have an active connector, rule, skill, package, route or fallback. Historical mentions must be explicitly historical and non-executable.
rules.watch: Research only; never route production work.
rules.desired_not_connected: Relevant/approved target capability, but no live connector/tool namespace is currently verified. Do not claim it works until connection + read smoke pass.
